title: Menger and Rothberger games on convergence spaces
summary: We introduce Menger and Rothberger selection principles and games for convergence spaces. Alice plays families that meet every convergent filter, and Bob's selections are required either to retain this property or merely to cover the underlying set. When the convergence is topological, both games recover the classical games. The winning condition requiring an $L$-cover satisfies analogues of the Hurewicz and Pawlikowski characterizations, the condition requiring a cover of $X$ is represented by the weak Menger and Rothberger games.
